projects.title: Skitech Digi-Progs — Digital Event Programs & Eulogies
projects.problem: Traditional printed event programs and eulogy booklets are costly to produce, easy to lose, and lack interactive digital access for guests during memorial services, weddings, and events
projects.solution: Developed an offline-first Progressive Web Application (PWA) that transforms printed booklets, memorial eulogies, wedding programs, and church bulletins into mobile-friendly digital experiences accessible via QR codes
projects.challenges: Implementing offline-first functionality for unreliable venue networks, building an embedded digital program viewer, and ensuring mobile responsiveness for fast QR code access
projects.impact: Live PWA serving interactive digital eulogies and event programs across Kenya with instant QR code access, offline caching, and zero printing overhead

projects.title: Skitech Smart Rider
projects.problem: Boda-boda riders need a seamless, error-free way for customers to pay them via mobile money without manually sharing or typing phone numbers
projects.solution: Developed a platform that generates permanent, unique QR codes linking to public payment profiles for riders, enabling quick scanning and seamless M-Pesa payments
projects.challenges: Designing an intuitive, mobile-first UI for riders on the go, integrating dynamic QR code generation, and establishing secure real-time database connections with Supabase
projects.impact: A live web application providing boda-boda riders with QR-based digital payment profiles, streamlining transactions and reducing payment errors

projects.title: AquaFlow — Hydration Tracker
projects.problem: People frequently forget to drink enough water throughout the day, with no engaging way to build a daily habit
projects.solution: Built a gamified hydration tracking web app with level progression, streak tracking, achievements, personalised reminders, and a beautiful animated UI to make staying hydrated fun
projects.challenges: Implementing persistent state without a backend, smooth animations, and a rewarding progression system that feels genuinely engaging rather than just functional
projects.impact: Live web application with gamified hydration tracking — levels from 'Thirsty Noob' to 'Aqua God', streak system, achievements, and smart reminders

projects.title: Business Website/Portfolio
projects.problem: A local business needed a professional online presence to showcase its services and make it easy for customers to get in touch
projects.solution: Designed and developed a fully responsive business website with modern UI/UX principles using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
projects.challenges: Ensuring responsive design across all devices while maintaining fast load times and implementing basic security practices
projects.impact: Live operational website that effectively showcases the client's services and drives customer engagement

projects.title: Lipana STK Push Payment System
projects.problem: Clients needed a seamless, automated mobile money payment integration for web applications
projects.solution: Built a full-stack M-Pesa Lipana STK Push integration with a Python/Flask backend, real-time payment status tracking, and a responsive React frontend with success/failure feedback
projects.challenges: Handling async payment callbacks, real-time status polling, securing API credentials, and deploying on a free cloud tier with cold-start latency
projects.impact: Live payment solution enabling seamless M-Pesa transactions directly from a web interface, demonstrating real-world backend integration skills

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.problem: Need for a modern, interactive portfolio to showcase skills, projects, and professional background to employers and clients
projects.solution: Built a fully responsive single-page portfolio using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with dark mode, animated sections, CV download, and an integrated contact form
projects.challenges: Implementing seamless dark mode, animated name reveal, accessible contact form with email integration, and ensuring consistent experience across devices
projects.impact: Live, professional portfolio actively used to attract clients and job opportunities

projects.title: Graphic Design Projects
projects.problem: Small local businesses lacked professional digital branding to compete online
projects.solution: Created comprehensive digital branding materials including logos, fliers, certificates, e.t.c. for multiple clients
projects.challenges: Understanding diverse client needs and translating business values into cohesive visual identities
projects.impact: Engineered cohesive visual identities that significantly elevated the professional presence and market competitiveness of local businesses

projects.title: Burp Suite Vulnerability Assessment
projects.problem: Web applications vulnerable to common security threats like XSS and SQL injection
projects.solution: Conducted comprehensive security audits using Burp Suite to identify and document vulnerabilities in test environments
projects.challenges: Identifying vulnerabilities without disrupting live systems and documenting findings effectively
projects.impact: Identified critical XSS and SQLi vulnerabilities, providing actionable recommendations for remediation
